_about: Per-camera no-fish-zones. The detector reliably emits false-positive boxes on stationary reef geometry — notably the dark oval holes in the SEAHIVE artificial reef. Any detection whose bbox center falls inside a region listed below is dropped before reaching the classifier, so it never lands in detection_events or the reviewer queue.

_format.polygon: list of [x, y] integer image-pixel coordinates. Vertices joined in order; the last vertex connects back to the first.
_format.frame_w / frame_h: image resolution the polygon was annotated against. If the camera resolution changes, the filter rescales polygons proportionally at load time.

_admin_ui: Draw + save regions interactively at /admin/regions.html on the dashboard.
